description: Intel Corporation is a global designer and manufacturer of semiconductor products, and the CPUs and other semiconductor solutions it designs, manufactures, markets, sells and services are incorporated in computing and related end products and services, and utilized globally by consumers, enterprises, governments and educational organizations. Its customers primarily include OEMs, ODMs, cloud service providers and other manufacturers and service providers such as industrial and communication equipment manufacturers, and it markets and sells its products through a combination of direct sales through its global sales organization and indirect channels including distributors, resellers, retailers and OEM partners. As a U.S.-based integrated design manufacturer, in addition to designing CPUs and other semiconductor products it develops leading-edge semiconductor manufacturing process technologies and advanced packaging technologies and predominantly manufactures its semiconductor products at its manufacturing and assembly and test facilities, many of which are in the U.S., making it the only company undertaking research, design and development of leading-edge and next generation semiconductor manufacturing technologies and high-volume manufacturing of logic semiconductors utilizing leading-edge nodes in the U.S.
